text:
Sam: quick holiday shout  Friday were doing a 20-min "micro-parade" at 3pm for ugly sweaters, festive badges, and a 2-min gingerbread house show-and-tell. low pressure, low cleanup.

Priya: Ooh. can we add a 'most creative snack' category? i will bring biscotti.

Jorge: Ill join the parade. is there a dress-code? casual chaos or strictly ugly sweaters? :sweat_smile:

Mei: Casual chaos. badges encouraged. if you want to enter gingerbread houses for the 2-min show, sign up here: "Name  entry title". winners get a tiny trophy sticker.

Claire: food note: please label if contains nuts. also the office fridge is small  try not to bring large trays.

Sam: promo blurb i'll post in #announcements later. quick rules for gingerbread show (copy/paste):
```
- 2 minute max for show-and-tell
- must be desk-sized (no full kitchen builds)
- please keep icing/glitter to a minimum
- mark any nut-containing snacks
```

LunchBot: Reminder: "Micro holiday parade" scheduled Fri 15:00 PT. Duration: 20m. Add to calendar? Reply 'yes'.

Priya: Priya  biscotti artistry

Jorge: Jorge  tiny gingerbread lighthouse

Mei: Mei  mismatch badge + peppermint bark (contains nuts)

Claire: Claire  an attempt at a gingerbread laptop (safe to say it's experimental)

Sam: ok re: parking for anyone coming in  Visitor lot C fills fast; try for street parking or carpooling. if you're bringing something fragile, message me and i'll reserve a tiny desk space.

Priya: can we have a virtual option? two of my friends are remote and might want to join camera cameo.

Sam: yes! we'll stream a short room cam and give remote folks 30s to show theirs.

Jorge: who is bringing glue? i forgot mine. :grimacing:

Mei: i have extra royal icing, but it's in a tub. i'll bring spatulas and a roll of parchment paper.

Claire: i'm bringing a roll of brown craft paper for the table. glitter containment plan engaged.

Sam: beautiful. i'll drop a short poll in the thread for best time confirmation: 3pm or 4pm? react with :three: or :four:.

Priya: :three:

Jorge: :three:

Mei: :four: (timezone thing for me)

Claire: :three:

Sam: tally: 3pm leads 3-1. sticking with 3pm. thanks everyone  see you for tiny trophies and questionable architecture. :trophy::gingerbread:
